_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Sourced 2026-07-05. Original Bugaboo Butterfly (2022 one-second-fold ultra-compact travel stroller) — the predecessor to the Butterfly 2. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Bugaboo Butterfly (original)

clekListed.clekRow: Bugaboo | Butterfly | Bugaboo Butterfly car seat adapter | 100045001

specs._weightNote: 16.09 lb with seat (ANB Baby spec sheet); often rounded to 16.1 lb by retailers.
specs._dimsNote: Folded 17.72 x 9.06 x 21.26 in is IATA cabin-compatible (fits overhead bins). Per ANB Baby / Strolleria spec sheets.

brake.type: foot-operated single central parking pedal engaging both rear wheels (flip-flop friendly)

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: 6 months to approx. 4 years in the seat; from birth with a compatible infant car seat + car seat adapter (100045001)

safety.standards: Not individually published as a numbered standard by Bugaboo; all strollers sold in the US must comply with 16 CFR 1227 (which incorporates ASTM F833). Bugaboo states its products are tested beyond industry safety standards.
safety.notes: 5-point harness; JPMA certification not confirmed/published for this model. Max child height not published by manufacturer (null).

specs.foldType: one-second, one-hand ultra-compact self-standing fold (IATA cabin-approved)
specs.recline: one-hand recline 111 to 145 degrees; 5-position adjustable integrated leg rest
specs.tires: front 4.7 in swivel wheels / rear 6 in; 4-wheel suspension (tire material not published)

notes: SUPERSEDED generation: the original Butterfly (2022) has been replaced by the Butterfly 2 (2024/2025). Bugaboo.com no longer sells it (that page redirects to Butterfly 2); it remains available at some retailers (Little Sprout $399.99 in stock; ANB Baby $384.99 out of stock; Pottery Barn Kids lists it as No Longer Available). A prime light/compact city+travel candidate: ~16.1 lb, one-second one-hand fold to 17.72 x 9.06 x 21.26 in (cabin size). Key differences vs Butterfly 2: smaller 4.7 in front wheels (vs 5.5 in) and a slightly lower canopy. Clek Liing attaches via the Bugaboo Butterfly car seat adapter 100045001 (adapter-100045001) — distinct from the Butterfly 2 adapter 400018003; the two are NOT interchangeable.
